name: Suzhou Dongshan Precision Manufacturing Co., Ltd.
summary: Suzhou Dongshan Precision Manufacturing Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells printed circuit boards (PCBs), precision components, touch panels and liquid crystal modules, and optical transceivers. It offers electronic circuits, such as flexible printed circuits, rigid-flex PCBs, and package substrates; precision components, including automotive components and telecommunications equipment components; and touch panels and liquid crystal modules, including touch panels and liquid crystal display and organic light-emitting diode modules.
